1.consolidated_definition: "Picapleitos": (m.) Dícese de la persona que actúa teatralmente.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Theatrical Performer 

(m.) Said of a person who acts theatrically.

Note: This term is used in Puerto Rican Spanish to describe someone who behaves in an overly dramatic or theatrical manner.
